quiz.question: What is one advantage of applying the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) to your code?

answers.answer: It makes your code execute faster.
It enhances maintainability by localizing changes.
It makes your code more visually appealing.
It reduces the need for documentation.
By making the classes larger and more complex.
By removing the need for tests completely.
By making smaller, single-purpose classes that are easier to unit test.
By integrating multiple functionalities into one class.

quiz.question: In the given code example, why are there two separate classes for generating and printing reports?

answers.answer: To increase the number of lines of code.
To keep the actions of generating and printing reports separated, each with a single responsibility.
To confuse the developers and maintainers.
Because Dart requires different classes for each action.
